import re

def slugify(value):
    # Convert to lowercase
    value = value.lower()
    # Replace any whitespace (including multiple spaces, tabs, newlines) with a single hyphen
    value = re.sub(r'\s+', '-', value)
    # Remove leading and trailing hyphens
    value = value.strip('-')
    return value
